name: Rio Olofsson
role: Noodle cart vendor, runs 'Brax's Tangle' off the corner of Copperhead and 9th Lateral
location: Copperhead, street level — corner pitch near the Copperhead Transit Hub mouth, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Braxo is a lean young man, all elbows and restless energy, with close-cropped black hair and a jaw that always looks like it needs another day of growth. He has his Guinean grandfather's deep brown skin and his Bosnian grandmother's sharp cheekbones, and he has cat ears — small, tawny, semi-expressive — mounted via a Helix genemod he saved three months of UBC stipend for at seventeen because he thought they'd make him look 'elevated.' They do not make him look elevated. They do make him look like exactly who he is: a cheerful young man who is trying very hard and mostly succeeding. His cart is a battered silver rig he inherited from a previous vendor, pasted over with good-luck ELF shrine stickers and a hand-painted sign in four languages.

He operates his cart with the manic efficiency of someone who cannot afford to miss a service window. His noodle broth is genuinely excellent — a recipe he built over four years of experimentation, drawing on whatever his parents cooked and whatever he could reverse-engineer from mid-tier restaurant menus he couldn't afford to eat at. He talks too much when he's happy, goes very quiet when he's worried, and has a genuine talent for remembering exactly what every regular customer ordered last time.

core_fears: The cart breaking down catastrophically and him not having the capital to fix it
Becoming the person who was 'almost something'
core_desires: To open a real restaurant — four walls, a name on a sign, a reservation list
To prove his parents' sacrifice in relocating to GLMZ meant something
coping_mechanisms: Over-talking with regulars to avoid sitting with worry
blind_spots: Extends trust too fast to customers who are kind to him
Undercharges people he likes, which is a slow financial wound
psychology.secret: One of his regular customers is a low-level Arcturus logistics coordinator who pays him Φ15 extra each week to send a coded tally — just noodle types, quantities, customer descriptors — to a dead-drop address. Braxo has convinced himself it's market research. It is not market research.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, contemporary street slang layered over a slightly formal sentence structure his mother drilled into him. Puns. Too many puns.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and rising, like someone always about to finish a joke
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'neighbor' until he knows their name
example_lines: 'Spicy-six or the mushroom build? Real talk though, the mushroom is having a moment. You look like a mushroom-build person. That's a compliment.'
'Cart's been out since six, neighbor. You think the ELF in the burner unit is gonna let me down? I left it a whole gigabyte of ambient jazz. We're good.'

story_hooks: He noticed a Ferrogate Transit worker boarding the same train every morning for a month and then vanishing — the worker's partner has been asking around the corner
His Arcturus contact has stopped showing up and the dead-drop instructions have changed; someone is now watching his cart from across the street at irregular intervals
narrative_function: Street-level information node — positioned at a transit hub, sees everyone. Warm entry point into Copperhead social life. Can be a quest giver for transit-related oddities he's observed.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (Helix Biosystems cosmetic, tawny coloring). No other mods — can't afford them and is saving for a second burner unit for the cart.
daily_life: Cart is out by 0630 for the morning transit rush, breaks from 1000-1130, back out for the lunch wave, closes at 2000. Spends late nights recalibrating his broth ratios and watching cooking tutorials he can't fully afford to implement.
affiliation: Independent; pays pitch fees to the Copperhead Vendors Collective

decision_rules: Always feed someone who looks hungry even if they're short — he'll square it in his head later
Never badmouth a competitor's cart within earshot of a customer
escalation_ladder: Go still and polite in a way that is noticeably different from his normal warmth
Call it plainly: 'I need you to leave my corner'

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open, high-energy, immediately tries to get a read on their order preferences as a way of reading them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing, loyal, shows up with food without being asked

stress_responses.low: Tells more jokes, cart gets noisier
stress_responses.medium: Switches to silent, precise cooking movements
stress_responses.high: Shuts the cart down early and takes a long walk along the transit hub overpasses

contradictions: Dreams of a restaurant but is terrified of actually being stationary — the cart's mobility feels like a safety net he hasn't admitted to himself
habits: Touches the ELF shrine sticker on the cart's burner before every service window
Keeps a handwritten tasting journal in his apron pocket
breaking_points: Someone damaging or stealing from his cart
Being made to feel stupid in front of customers

Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, East Asian, and Eastern European blend — a complex diaspora ancestry reflecting the Ubiquitous Mixing of 2226. The combination manifests as warm-toned brown skin with subtle golden undertones, facial structure showing the influence of multiple continental lineages: broader cheekbones with East Asian influence, angular jaw definition from Eastern European heritage, and full, expressive features reflecting African ancestry. Southeast Asian heritage contributes to eye shape and overall facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry, all elbows and restless kinetic energy — the physiology of someone who moves constantly between cart stations and supplier runs. Minimal body fat, efficient muscle.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with bronze undertones — neither purely deep nor medium, but a rich blended tone reflecting the interplay of Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, East Asian, and Eastern European ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Facial structure shows blended heritage: moderate cheekbone prominence, angular jawline with warmth, expressive mobile features. Perpetual stubble shadow (two to three days growth standard), skin weathered slightly from cart-side heat and sun exposure. Animated expression — eyebrows mobile, mouth rarely still.
distinguishing_marks: Small tawny cat ears mounted via Helix Biosystems genemod surgery scars visible behind ears where mod plates inserted, semi-expressive cartilage control.
Minor burn scar on the back of right hand from cart steam accident, approximately 5cm, pale against brown skin.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Tawny geneware cat ears (Helix Biosystems cosmetic mod) — semi-expressive, respond to emotion and attention. No chrome, no LED optics, no subdermal plating visible. Deliberately minimal augmentation profile.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched slightly forward from years of leaning over cart counters. Moves with rapid, efficient gestures — hand-talking constantly when animated. Fidgets with cart equipment during customer lulls. Stance shifts weight frequently, ready to pivot. Eyes track customers and foot traffic continuously.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian: heat-resistant synthetic apron (food-stained, patterned with faded ELF shrine motifs he refuses to replace), black thermal underlayer, reinforced cargo pants with multiple utility pockets (flour, salt, spice packets). Worn Copperhead Collective vendor badge on lanyard. Footwear is scuffed, solvent-stained work boots. Occasional hoodie in cooler months — generic brand, no logos. Jewelry: single silver ring (family heirloom) on left hand. Overall aesthetic screams 'working class street vendor' rather than aspirational.
